光学的厚さ0.7の一様平板。正の半球から単位強度が入射し、逆向きの入射・散乱・内部放射はゼロです。 採用した計算法 正のGauss–Legendre離散方向と1次風上有限体積の空間行進を使います。角度誤差だけを分ける系列では、一定セル内を指数関数で正確に伝播します。 μdIdτ+I=0,I(τ,μ)=e−τ/μμdτdI​+I=0,I(τ,μ)=e−τ/μ Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux. Assumptions, units and boundaries A uniform slab of optical depth 0.7 receives unit intensity over the positive hemisphere, with zero reverse inflow, scattering and emission. Adopted numerical method Use positive Gauss–Legendre ordinates and first-order upstream finite-volume marching. A separate angular-error sweep uses exact exponential propagation within each constant cell. μdIdτ+I=0,I(τ,μ)=e−τ/μμdτdI​+I=0,I(τ,μ)=e−τ/μ Fout=2π∫01μe−τ/μdμ=2πE3(τ)Fout​=2π∫01​μe−τ/μdμ=2πE3​(τ) References and measured quantities With 32–512 cells, check all ray intensities, spatial flux error, positivity and discrete absorption balance. A separate 4–32-ordinate sweep compares exit flux with the analytic 2pi E3(tau) representation. Verification limits and failures Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
